beats.hook: At 3 AM, all our databases crashed
beats.voice: At three in the morning, every single primary database dropped offline at once.

beats.caption: The Investigation|Traffic was normal|CPU at 100%|Connection pool drained
beats.voice: Traffic was completely normal, yet CPU usage was pegged at one hundred percent with zero available connections.

beats.after: Missing index on a background health check query
beats.voice: The team assumed a cyber attack, but the actual cause was a single unindexed query running every ten seconds.

beats.hook: Index the queries you run the most
beats.voice: Always index the queries you run the most, before they take you down.
